title: fix: bill AssemblyAI transcription add-ons
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds request-priced AssemblyAI transcription sheets using the official [pricing](https://www.assemblyai.com/pricing): Universal-2 diarization is $0.17/hour.
- Bills Universal-3.5 Pro at $0.21/hour base, $0.26 with prompting, $0.23 with diarization, and $0.28 with both.
- Leaves canonical names, aliases, provider routes, access, capabilities, and fallback behavior unchanged.
- Verified all six combinations directly with AssemblyAI and through local Gen, including catalog prices, exact wallet debits, billing events, and a no-charge cache hit.
- Tests: cost variants, effective-price snapshot, AssemblyAI transcription, model permissions, Gen/Enter typechecks, Biome.

gist.headline: The transcription tab adds up
gist.blurb: AssemblyAI transcription add-ons now get their own neatly labeled pollen cells. Polli checked the receipt six different ways, because audio settings apparently contain multitudes.
gist.summary: Added request-priced AssemblyAI transcription cost variants: Universal-2 diarization at $0.17/hour and Universal-3.5 Pro at $0.21/hour base, $0.26 with prompting, $0.23 with diarization, or $0.28 with both.
gist.impact: AssemblyAI transcription requests now produce wallet debits and billing events that accurately match the selected Universal-2 or Universal-3.5 Pro add-ons, while cache hits remain free.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy audio-billing garden: Polli acts as a careful sound engineer and accountant beside a retro transcription terminal, sorting labeled waveform receipts into four small jars for Universal-3.5 Pro configurations and one diarization jar. Tiny code-plants, flowers, and a softly glowing lime-green ledger make accurate per-hour pricing feel like tending a well-organized hive.
